# Elastic Email Examples

> Runnable code samples for the Elastic Email email API (REST API v4, official SDKs 4.2.0): transactional and bulk sending, templates, attachments, webhooks, inbound email routing, contacts, double opt-in, suppressions, sending domains and account statistics - in 21 languages, frameworks and serverless platforms.

Every example reads `ELASTICEMAIL_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM` and `EMAIL_TO` from `.env`. `EMAIL_FROM` must belong to a domain verified in Elastic Email. The API base URL is `https://api.elasticemail.com/v4` and authentication is the `X-ElasticEmail-ApiKey` header. Webhooks are unsigned GET requests with event data in the query string; the examples verify a shared `?token=` secret with a constant-time compare. Inbound email arrives as a form POST.

A machine-readable map from use case to source file for every stack is in [examples.json](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/examples.json). All guides and quickstarts in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/llms-full.txt).

## Guides

- [Overview](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/README.md): the API in one paragraph and the conventions every stack follows
- [Environment variables](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/environment-variables.md): every variable, where it is used, what breaks without it
- [Sending email](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/sending-email.md): transactional vs bulk, merge fields, scheduling, threading, delivery lookup
- [Attachments](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/attachments.md): file attachments and inline (CID) images
- [Templates](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/templates.md): hosted templates, merge values, creating one from code
- [Contacts and lists](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/contacts-and-lists.md): lists, contact CRUD, statuses, custom fields
- [Double opt-in](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/double-opt-in.md): HMAC confirmation link vs the Clicked event
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/webhooks.md): events, parameters, the token scheme, handler design
- [Inbound email](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/inbound-email.md): inbound routes, MX setup, parsed fields
- [Suppressions](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/suppressions.md): unsubscribes, bounces, complaints
- [Domains and deliverability](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/domains-and-deliverability.md): SPF, DKIM, MX, DMARC, tracking, warm-up
- [Account](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/account.md): statistics, email verification, sub-accounts
- [Error handling](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/error-handling.md): the error body and how each SDK surfaces it
- [API map](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/api-map.md): use case to SDK method name in every language
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): symptom to cause for common failures

## Quickstarts

- [Send email with Next.js](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/nextjs-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Next.js 15 route handlers and server actions, TypeScript and JavaScript
- [Send email with PHP](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/php-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): elasticemail-php SDK, Slim and Symfony
- [Send email with Laravel](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/laravel-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Laravel 11 controllers and an Artisan command
- [Send email with Python](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/python-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): ElasticEmail PyPI SDK, Flask, FastAPI, Django
- [Send email with Ruby](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/ruby-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): ElasticEmail gem, Sinatra and Rails
- [Send email with Go](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/go-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): elasticemail-go/v4, Chi and Gin
- [Send email with Java](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/java-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): elasticemail-java via JitPack, Javalin and Spring Boot
- [Send email with .NET](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/dotnet-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): ElasticEmail NuGet package, Minimal APIs and MVC
- [Send email with Rust](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/rust-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): elasticemail-rust, Axum
- [Send email with Elixir](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/elixir-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): REST API through Req, Phoenix
- [Send email with Node.js](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/nodejs-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): plain Node.js with node:http and no framework, TypeScript and JavaScript
- [Send email with Express](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/express-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Express 5, TypeScript and JavaScript
- [Send email with Hono](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/hono-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Hono 4, TypeScript and JavaScript
- [Send email with Bun](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/bun-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Bun.serve(), TypeScript and JavaScript
- [Send email with Remix](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/remix-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Remix 2 resource routes
- [Send email with Nuxt](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/nuxt-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Nuxt 3 server routes
- [Send email with SvelteKit](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/sveltekit-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): SvelteKit 2 +server endpoints
- [Send email with Astro](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/astro-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Astro 5 API endpoints
- [Send email with RedwoodJS](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/redwoodjs-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): RedwoodJS 8 functions
- [Send email with TanStack Start](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/tanstack-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): TanStack Start server routes
- [Send email from serverless](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/serverless-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Supabase Edge, AWS Lambda, Deno Deploy, Netlify, Railway, Encore
- [Send your first email with SMTP](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/smtp-elasticemail-examples/QUICKSTART.md): the SMTP relay (smtp.elasticemail.com) with curl, then Auth0, Customer.io, Liferay, Metabase, Retool, Supabase, WordPress, Node.js (no dependencies), Nodemailer, NextAuth, PHPMailer, Laravel, Django, Rails

## For coding agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository layout, conventions and the rules that are easy to get wrong
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-examples/blob/main/skills/elasticemail/SKILL.md): step-by-step instructions for adding Elastic Email to an existing project
- [Elastic Email MCP server](https://github.com/ElasticEmail/elasticemail-mcp-server): lets an agent send email, manage contacts, campaigns and templates through MCP
